name: Nixa (United States)
description: White field between two dark blue vertical stripes at the hoist and fly, charged with a red saltire of four arrowheads.
history: Nixa is a city in Christian County, Missouri. The flag was adopted on 25 September 2023 (chosen by 43.7% of 1,160 public votes and adopted unanimously by city council Resolution 2023-047 on 25 September 2023, according to Flags of the World).
